title: Kid Ory and advertising on the corner against rival bands
summary: Desvigne worked alongside Kid Ory without being in his band, with competing bands advertising on the corner.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What did you remember? He played drums and trombone on them. Trombone, Celestine. Yeah, but he played drums, too, one time. That was Bebe Matthews. Bill Matthews, brother. Oh, yeah. Oh, Kid Ora, did you ever work with him? Oh, Kid Ora, I never did. I worked with him, you know, but I never was a member of the band. I worked with him. We'd work together, you know, and I'd play in the dance, where they'd have two bands. We'd catch each other on the corner, you know, advertising, and we'd play against each other, you know. Like Buck.
